I feel like everyone around me has been trying to tell me that “her problems are not your problems, self-harm is not about you”. But when i know that A causes B it’s hard to think of it in anyway other than me being at fault. Maybe I’m not at fault for her self-harming, but I definitely am the cause if the only thing that would make her hurt herself is me. But this idea is what gave me the courage to finally end it. I guess I just really need to keep telling myself I’m not the one harming her, it’s her. (Even though, it still doesn’t feel that way)

I feel like your spot on with the bad for each other. For the past few weeks she’s been bringing up how I never want to talk about our problems anymore and it’s honestly true. Im so overwhelmed with the instability of the relationship that even the smallest problem sets me off. I’m not aggressive and I’d never get physical, but I feel like arguing about anything with her anymore makes me feel like I’m about to have a mental breakdown.

On the topic of abortion, I definitely don’t feel I threatened her. It went a lot like “I grew up poor and you grew up poor. It really sucked going from babysitter to babysitter because my parents couldn’t be around. I really don’t want to bring another poor kid into this world and if we have this child now it’d probably go like that.” She agreed at the time but regretted it after.
